caption: The drawing depicts a single woven basket positioned centrally on a plain, light beige background. The basket has a circular shape with a lattice, criss-cross pattern on its sides, created by interwoven strands in hues of reddish-brown, brown, and shades of blue. The top rim and base of the basket are more solidly woven in a reddish-brown color, while the interlaced areas contain both reddish-brown and blue sections, creating a pattern of diamond-shaped openings. The basket has two handles, one visible in the foreground and the other partially visible in the background, both made from twisted strand material in a reddish-brown color and fastened at the ends with olive green wrapping. The base of the basket is reinforced with a thick twisted rope accent in yellow ochre and brown tones. The basket is framed by a simple, thin, black outline close to the edges of the paper.
title: Pottery Basket
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
